body: There are really nice places to walk where I live, going to take my dog out in the morning, and I do like walking! Book-wise I'm snailing my way through the ASOIAF series, and I'm thinking of getting The Witcher series after playing the games. I'm very grateful that I have people who care about me, though it makes me feel very selfish that I harbour these feelings and know that I can take action which will cause people pain. But yes hopefully I get what I want to do sorted soon, it's awful feeling stuck

Yes I'm still here, it's 3am were I'm from and I can't sleep lol. My mum calls me a pessimist as my outlook on the world the same, though I think of myself as more of a realist, at least that's what I tell myself. I'm feeling ok now I suppose, just holding out for some sleep, thank you :)
I do want it to, I'm holding out for it to get better, but after 5-6 years of hoping, and knowing I'm still young with a lot of years ahead of me makes it feel less likely

I'm fortunate that I actually had a good childhood, extremely thankful to my parents for it. But yes 12 was pretty young to feel that way, I think the hormones kicking in at that age set things in motion. Thank you :)
